newsitem.title: CHINA: China's president gives away gifts to poor.
newsitem.headline: China's president gives away gifts to poor.

text.p: China's President Jiang Zemin stoked a growing personality cult on Friday with the announcement that he had donated gifts received during state visits abroad to poverty stricken Chinese schools.

The president and Communist Party chief gave away 20 colour televisions, video recorders and video compact disc players to primary and middle schools in poor southwestern and western areas to support basic education, the Xinhua news agency said.
Jiang had been given the electronic equipment during foreign visits, Xinhua said.

The president this week launched a campaign to try to eradicate poverty, and reports of his speeches have filled official media this week as he prepares for an annual party plenum expected next month.
